edits.match: Reversal is likewise drug-specific: vitamin K for warfarin, protamine for heparin, idarucizumab for dabigatran, and andexanet alfa, which NICE recommends for life-threatening or uncontrolled bleeding on apixaban or rivaroxaban.
edits.replacement: Reversal is likewise drug-specific: vitamin K for warfarin, protamine for heparin, idarucizumab for dabigatran, and andexanet alfa for apixaban or rivaroxaban, which NICE recommends only for life-threatening or uncontrolled gastrointestinal bleeding.
edits.reason: WRONG: NICE TA697 recommends andexanet alfa only for life-threatening or uncontrolled gastrointestinal bleeding and explicitly not for intracranial or other major bleeds; the sentence overstated the recommendation.

notes: Search spent on the NICE andexanet claim (the only NEW claim likely to be overstated). NHS side-effect list (dizziness, headaches, hair loss, jaundice; warning signs of bleeding) and the DOAC-first/warfarin-for-mechanical-valves statements are consistent with NHS/NICE NG196 but the cited NHS and StatPearls pages were not retrieved.
